characters.name: Gutten
characters.prompt: A young, clever boy with a mischievous smile, walking along a path with pockets filled with nuts. He is wearing traditional Norwegian clothing from the folktale era, featuring a light-colored shirt and knee-length trousers. His hair is tousled, and he has an adventurous sparkle in his eye.

characters.name: Fanden
characters.prompt: A mystical, sinister figure capable of transforming his size at will. He appears as a small, twisted creature, with a devilish grin and sharp, crafty eyes. His forms vary from tiny, like a worm, to mysterious and shadowy, with dark, ethereal clothing that hint at his devilish nature.

characters.name: Smeden
characters.prompt: A robust and muscular blacksmith, wearing a leather apron and wielding a heavy hammer. His face is stern with concentration, brows furrowed as he stands in a traditional smidje (blacksmith's shop) with an anvil and tools scattered around. His expression changes from focused to surprised as he realizes his hammering impact.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An illustration capturing a young boy cleverly trapping an eerie, mischievous devil inside a large nut, on a sunny Norwegian countryside road. Nearby, a large blacksmith shop is visible, with curious onlookers peering in as the blacksmith prepares to smash the nut with a giant hammer.
modernMainImagePrompt: A modern-day setting with a clever young boy holding a smartphone, attempting to capture a digital image of a small devil character trying to escape from a nut. The background shows a bustling city street with a contemporary blacksmith shop exhibiting advanced machinery and curious passersby.
childMainImagePrompt: A vibrant and colorful illustration for children showing a cheerful boy and a tiny, funny devil character playing a game of hide and seek inside a big, cartoonish nut. The scene is set in a friendly, enchanted forest with animals watching curiously, and the blacksmith is smiling, hammer in hand, ready to join the fun.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: A modern depiction in Norwegian with a young boy outsmarting a small, tricky devil inside a nut. The setting is a picturesque Norwegian village with a blacksmith shop in the background, showing the moment the nut cracks open with a touch of magic.
englishMainImagePrompt: An enchanting illustration depicting a clever boy and a devil engaged in a playful yet cunning encounter, where the boy traps the devil inside a nut. In the setting, a traditional blacksmith's workshop is prepared to open the nut with a mighty swing, capturing the essence of a timeless folk tale with humor and surprise.
